_comment: THE-COVERAGE-FLOOR ratchet marker. coverage-from-run.mjs FAILS the harness coverage phase when the run-derived routes-content-reached drops below this floor. Raise it only after a green witnessed run measures higher; never lower it to make a run pass — a drop is a regression to fix. Earlier: LOWERED 50 -> 49 on 2026-08-29 (THE-DEAD-INVITATION): the route PARENT shrank 54 -> 53 because /invitation was DELETED by owner ruling (dead on both the OSS and CE backends — neither mounts its mint/validate/consume flow). A deliberate parent shrink is the ONLY legitimate lowering; this is not a regression waiver. 49 was OBSERVED in the same run that witnessed the floor violation before this edit.
